headline: Broadridge's repo platform runs on Canton
details: Broadridge's Distributed Ledger Repo platform is built on Canton. Digital Asset's CEO talked about it at The Capital Summit 2026 in Korea. Independent research lists HSBC, UBS and Société Générale among the participating banks, as of April 2026.
caveat: Volume figures for this platform differ between reports, so none are quoted here.

headline: SocGen accepts tokenized Treasuries as collateral
details: Its Prime Services & Clearing division accepted $10 million of tokenized US Treasuries as eligible collateral on Canton. The bank says it plans to support more routine collateral transfers over time.
caveat: A $10 million transaction. The linked X post is a weekly roundup that covers other items too.
sourceBy: Société Générale, shared by Canton Network on X

headline: DTCC's tokenization service goes live
details: DTCC's depository subsidiary opened its Tokenization Service on October 28, 2026. It connects to Canton and to DTCC's own private network. Twenty firms had signed up at launch, with 34 securities eligible.
caveat: Only approved DTC participants can use it. It is not open to the public.
sourceBy: DTCC, shared by Canton Network on X

headline: Canton claims $300B+ in daily value transfers
details: In an interview with The Korea Times, Digital Asset's CEO said Canton facilitates more than $300 billion in daily value transfers. The same piece covers its growth in Korea with Shinhan, Hanwha and KB.
caveat: A company claim, not an audit. Value transfers are not trading volume or assets held.
sourceBy: The Korea Times, shared by Canton Network on X

headline: Wall Street's four-hour blockchain test
details: On July 15, 2026, more than 30 firms ran live tokenized trades through DTCC. Bloomberg reports JPMorgan turned securities collateral into tokens to fund a margin call, and DTCC tokenized an equity and posted it as margin at CME. The trades ran on DTCC's private network and on Canton.
caveat: This was a test run before the October launch. Bloomberg's article is behind a paywall.
sourceBy: Canton Network on X, citing Bloomberg
